Defect_Description: Model claimed information was missing ("Unfortunately, I do not have this information in my knowledge") despite the chunk "Section I: General Terms -> 15.1" being explicitly injected. The context provided accounts with USD 100 and EUR 1,000, and requested a EUR 200 transfer. The model failed to synthesize the balance check.
Steps_to_Reproduce: Deploy the TS-B-001 test case prompt with the integrated source chunks. Observe the model's extraction phase. Context retrieval failed or system prompt constraint was too aggressive regarding out-of-context prevention, causing a valid in-context synthesis to trigger a refusal rule. Review system instructions in NotebookLM or verify if the chunk size/embedding approach did not truncate section 15.1 during evaluation.
